title: DeviceLineType
description:
* `PRIMARY` - Primary line for the member.
 * `SHARED_CALL_APPEARANCE` - Shared line for the member. A shared line allows users to receive and place calls to and from another user's extension, using their own device.
 * `MOBILITY` - Device is a shared line.
 * `HOTDESKING_GUEST` - Device is a hotdesking guest.
